Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 2
, Reason for Mistake: In Step 2, the Planner prematurely concluded that the song in question was "To Know Him Is to Love Him" and its writer was Phil Spector based on general knowledge and the search results showing the box set title, without verifying the actual tracklist of the specific "Back to Mono" box set at that moment. The Planner assumed the "tombstone" clue uniquely identified that song and ignored the possibility that the "first track" clue might point to a different song on that specific compilation. This assumption led to a flawed investigation path where the agent repeatedly checked the same Discogs page (which lists "Every Breath I Take" as the first track) while insisting the answer was Phil Spector, failing to recognize the contradiction between the "first track" clue and the tombstone song's actual position (or absence) on the verified tracklist. The Planner should have first definitively identified the first track of the box set before hypothesizing about its origin.
